choices.content:
Rotating a right triangle through one full revolution about a leg forms a cone

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_052_q4_choiceA_en.svg)

A car's windshield wiper sweeps out a sector-shaped region on the windshield

[Figure 2](figures/cnm_052_q4_choiceB_en.svg)

A meteor leaves a bright line as it crosses the night sky

[Figure 3](figures/cnm_052_q4_choiceC_en.svg)

A pen tip draws a curve on paper

[Figure 4](figures/cnm_052_q4_choiceD_en.svg)

question.prompt: Which of the following phenomena illustrates that “a moving surface generates a solid”?

solutions.explanation: A right triangle is a surface, and rotating it produces a cone, a solid figure, illustrating that a moving surface generates a solid. A windshield wiper illustrates that a moving line generates a surface; a meteor and a pen tip illustrate that a moving point generates a line.
solutions.title: Identify the moving geometric object
